description: "The Boy Travellers in The Russian Empire" by Thomas Wallace Knox is a travel account written in the late 19th century. The narrative follows two young characters, Frank Bassett and Fred Bronson, as they embark on a journey through various regions of Russia, including explorations across Siberia, visits to historical sites, and experiences with local cultures.
